summary: Chagee Holdings filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing board approval of a special cash dividend of approximately US$1.95 per ordinary share and per ADS, each ADS representing one Class A ordinary share. Payable in US dollars on or about December 4, 2026 to holders of record as of November 23, 2026, excluding depositary-held shares reserved for incentive plans. The board also adopted a three-year policy of annual dividends of at least 50% of prior-year net income starting fiscal 2027. Cash and restricted cash totaled RMB6,567.5 million (US$967.9 million) at June 30, 2026. Watch payout funding and ADS depositary fees.
